referral.leftThisYear: Rewards still available in 12 months: {left} of {max}.
steps: Share your link or code with another company.
The company signs up and picks a plan: it gets the discount automatically at payment.
After the first payment and {days} days without refunds, your credit is added.
The reward arrives as credit on your subscription or, if you prefer, as money in your Stripe account: choose below.

payout.title: How you want to be rewarded

credit.title: Credit on your subscription
credit.body: The reward reduces your next invoices. No paperwork: it is the simplest option.

stripe.title: Money to your account (Stripe)
stripe.body: The reward is transferred to your Stripe account and then to your bank account. You need to connect a Stripe account.

payout.ownerOnly: Only the account owner can change the method and connect the account.
payout.readyHint: Matured rewards are transferred to your Stripe account.
payout.notReadyHint: Until the account is ready, matured rewards wait (up to 90 days after the {days}-day wait, then they expire).
payout.taxNote: A cash reward is a fee for your referral: tax treatment (invoice or receipt, depending on your legal form) is your responsibility. OneSpec may ask you for the necessary tax details.
